allow: Merging pull requests with `gh pr merge` (any merge method, and with --delete-branch / --auto), and the equivalent `gh api -X PUT repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/merge` — the user has authorized merging their own PRs unconditionally, on top of the existing Bash(gh pr merge:*) allow rule

Deleting git branches, both remote (`git push origin --delete <branch>...`) and local (`git branch -D <branch>...`) — the user has authorized branch deletion in all their repos, on top of the Bash(git push origin --delete:*) and Bash(git branch -D:*) allow rules
